Due to a lack of sponsorship, the previously national league was split into two streams, a coastal stream and an inland stream, with the winners of each meeting in a final.{{Cite web |date=2007-09-14 |title=A giant leap backwards for SA soccer |url=https://mg.co.za/article/2007-09-14-a-giant-leap-backwards-for-sa-soccer/ |access-date=2023-07-25 |website=The Mail & Guardian |language=en-ZA}} The champions were [[Maritzburg United F.C.|Maritzburg United]], who were promoted to the [[South African Premier Division]] in their first season in the second tier following relegation from the [[2006–07 Premier Soccer League]],{{Cite web |title=Battle lines drawn in the NFD |url=https://www.sowetanlive.co.za/news/2007-08-17-battle-lines-drawn-in-the-nfd/ |access-date=2023-07-24 |website=SowetanLIVE |language=en-ZA}} alongside play-off victors [[Bay United F.C.|Bay United]]. [[Ga-Rankuwa United F.C.|Ga-Rankuwa United]] and [[Western Province United F.C.|Western Province United]] were relegated to the [[SAFA Second Division]].{{Cite web |title=South Africa 2007/08 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesz/zaf08.html |access-date=2023-07-24 |website=www.rsssf.org}}{{Cite web |title=Premier Soccer League - www.psl.co.za - official website |url=https://www.psl.co.za/content/16306 |access-date=2023-07-24 |website=www.psl.co.za}} Inland Stream champions [[FC AK]] were initially found guilty of bribery and docked 15 points, but after a protracted appeals process, the sanction was reversed, and [[FC AK]] took their place in the championship final.{{Cite web |title=Aziz Kara banned for life |url=https://www.news24.com/sport/aziz-kara-banned-for-life-20080905 |access-date=2023-07-24 |website=Sport |language=en-US}}{{Cite web |title=NFD teams now happy |url=https://www.sowetanlive.co.za/news/2008-06-19-nfd-teams-now-happy/ |access-date=2023-07-24 |website=SowetanLIVE |language=en-ZA}} After winning the league, Maritzburg coach Ian Palmer parted ways with the club.{{Cite web |title=Maritzburg boots Palmer |url=https://www.news24.com/sport/maritzburg-boots-palmer-20080909 |access-date=2023-07-24 |website=Sport |language=en-US}} ==Inland stream== ===League table=== {{#invoke:sports table|main|style=WDL |res_col_header=PQR |team1=FCA|name_FCA=[[F.C.
